summary: The diff implements both REQ-1 and REQ-2. For REQ-1, Layout.tsx adds an Upload button in the fixed header (authenticated-only, navigates to /upload) and the file summary mentions a FAB for upload in the bottom navigation area. For REQ-2, Upload.tsx is rewritten with accept='video/*' and accept='image/*', a visible submit button with validation, chunked upload progress bars, and navigation to /feed on success. Coverage looks solid for both requirements.
